scope: Exact union of queried IC5 edge relations for the declared20inputs, plus their endpoint anchors and transitive owner roots. Generic node/edge records preserve original UUIDs, sequence, properties and ACL.

steps.name: inputs
steps.sql: CREATE TEMP TABLE align_inputs(idx int, id uuid, min_date bigint)

steps.name: knows
steps.sql: CREATE TEMP TABLE align_knows AS SELECT DISTINCT e.id FROM align_inputs i JOIN anchors e ON e.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND e.arch_type='Knows' AND (e.src=i.id OR e.dst=i.id)

steps.name: friends
steps.sql: CREATE TEMP TABLE align_friends AS SELECT DISTINCT i.idx,i.min_date,CASE WHEN e.src=i.id THEN e.dst ELSE e.src END AS id FROM align_inputs i JOIN anchors e ON e.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND e.arch_type='Knows' AND (e.src=i.id OR e.dst=i.id) JOIN anchors n ON n.id=CASE WHEN e.src=i.id THEN e.dst ELSE e.src END AND n.arch_type='Person'

steps.name: members
steps.sql: CREATE TEMP TABLE align_members AS SELECT DISTINCT e.id,e.src AS forum FROM align_friends f JOIN anchors e ON e.dst=f.id AND e.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND e.arch_type='HasMember' AND (e.props->'archetype'->>'joinDate')::bigint>f.min_date JOIN anchors n ON n.id=e.src AND n.arch_type='Forum'

steps.name: forums
steps.sql: CREATE TEMP TABLE align_forums AS SELECT DISTINCT forum AS id FROM align_members

steps.name: containers
steps.sql: CREATE TEMP TABLE align_containers AS SELECT e.id,e.dst AS post FROM align_forums f JOIN anchors e ON e.src=f.id AND e.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND e.arch_type='ContainerOf' JOIN anchors n ON n.id=e.dst AND n.arch_type='Post'

steps.name: posts
steps.sql: CREATE TEMP TABLE align_posts AS SELECT DISTINCT post AS id FROM align_containers

steps.name: creators
steps.sql: CREATE TEMP TABLE align_creators AS SELECT e.id FROM align_posts p JOIN anchors e ON e.src=p.id AND e.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND e.arch_type='HasCreator' JOIN anchors n ON n.id=e.dst AND n.arch_type='Person'

steps.name: edges
steps.sql: CREATE TEMP TABLE align_edges AS SELECT id FROM align_knows UNION SELECT id FROM align_members UNION SELECT id FROM align_containers UNION SELECT id FROM align_creators

steps.name: nodes
steps.sql: CREATE TEMP TABLE align_ids(id uuid PRIMARY KEY); INSERT INTO align_ids SELECT id FROM align_edges UNION SELECT a.src FROM anchors a JOIN align_edges e ON e.id=a.id WHERE a.src IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT a.dst FROM anchors a JOIN align_edges e ON e.id=a.id WHERE a.dst IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT id FROM align_inputs
